verdict.rationale: Gusto's evidence covers business formation, EIN registration, state compliance filings, registered agent service and payroll APIs. None of it documents drafting board consents or resolutions, or collecting board approvals online. Because Gusto now offers company formation and compliance, corporate-governance documents are a fair question for this product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can prepare board consents and resolutions and collect approvals online
